Initial release of gws-script.

- Introduces commands to manage Google Apps Script projects from the CLI.
- Supports listing and fetching data about script processes and projects.
- Provides methods to create projects, update content, get metrics, and manage deployments/versions.
- Includes helper command (+push) for uploading local files to a script project.
- Offers CLI inspection tools for resource discovery and schema details.
